## Agentic Data Cloud Architecture & GTM Playbook

Nov 23, 2026

Summary
- Enterprise architectures are shifting from static BI dashboards to proactive multi-agent data pipelines handling thousands of concurrent queries.
- Unified lakehouse federation enables zero-copy analytics across transactional databases and Apache Iceberg tables.
- Serverless microVM database pooling cuts agent cold-start provisioning to under 2 seconds with per-second autoscaling.
- Field GTM motion aligns around three repeatable plays: Unified Data+AI Modernization, Analytics-First, and Operational Database Migration.

Next steps
- [Alex Rivera] Share the reference architecture deck and multi-cloud benchmark examples with the regional account leads.
- [Program Host] Schedule a 1:1 portfolio review covering the top 10 strategic accounts prior to Q1 planning.
